title: A planted test proves drop of a sprint takes its research and review stories and refuses while a live or claimed item remains
goal: Found by the SP-m3azo2y7 review of BG-j7f3dlop: no suite test covers drop of a sprint; the only proof was the item's repro, which close deletes, so a regression in sprint_leftovers, its refusal on a non-dropped item or a claimed story, or the 'i not in gone' save guard (_tools/bl_items.py) passes every gate. One planted-failure test, within the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json (fold into an existing scenario while the suite sits at 100 ids), runs drop on a planned sprint in an isolated git repo and asserts check errors=0, and asserts the two refusals.
